Hyprland 0.56.2 IPC traffic, reconstructed from Hyprland's source at tag
v0.56.2 (the files and wiki page cited below), not captured from a
running Hyprland. M3's exit box "runs on Hyprland, niri and sway" is
where real captures replace or validate these files.

Request replies (.socket.sock, one request per connection; Hyprland writes
the reply and closes): j/monitors, j/workspaces, j/clients, j/activewindow,
one directory per moment of the scenario (boot, opened, closed). The JSON
follows the format strings of src/debug/HyprCtl.cpp at tag v0.56.2
(getMonitorData, getWorkspaceData, getWindowData, activeWindowRequest:
`{}` when no window has focus): 4-space indentation, field order, a
trailing comma after each monitor/window object removed by
trimTrailingComma, addresses as "0x%x", `fullscreen` as a mode number.

events.txt holds .socket2.sock lines ("EVENT>>DATA\n") as Hyprland 0.56.2
emits them (wiki content/ipc/_index.md, "Events list"): addresses in events
carry no "0x", every v2 event follows its v1 twin, `configreloaded>>` has
empty data. Lines starting with `#` and blank lines are the test's
markers, not traffic; `## name` starts the burst the test sends as one
write.

Scenario: two monitors (DP-1 focused, HDMI-A-1), workspaces 1 and 2 on
DP-1, 3 on HDMI-A-1, special:magic on DP-1 with pavucontrol; kitty on 1.
